items.title: Trimble (NASDAQ:TRMB) posts Q3 2026 sales in line with estimates but stock drops
items.summary: Geospatial technology provider Trimble (NASDAQ:TRMB) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue up 7.3% year on year to $966.8 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $1.05 billion was less impressive, coming in 0.6% below analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.86 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
